info.name: SRD 5.1: Monk
info.description: The monk class with its SRD subclass.
info.author: dndbuilder contributors (SRD 5.1 content by Wizards of the Coast, CC-BY-4.0)

description.p: Monks make careful study of a magical energy they call ki, channeling it into their strikes and movement.

Hit Dice: 1d8 per monk level. Proficiencies: simple weapons, shortswords; one artisan’s tool or musical instrument. Saving throws: Strength, Dexterity. Skills: choose two from Acrobatics, Athletics, History, Insight, Religion and Stealth.

setters.set: A master of martial arts, harnessing the power of the body in pursuit of physical and spiritual perfection.

description.p: While you are wearing no armor and not wielding a shield, your AC equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Wisdom modifier.

While unarmed or wielding only monk weapons (shortswords and simple melee weapons without the two-handed or heavy property) and not wearing armor or a shield: you can use Dexterity instead of Strength for attack and damage rolls, roll a martial arts die in place of normal damage, and make one unarmed strike as a bonus action after taking the Attack action.

sheet.description: Martial arts die d{{martial arts:die}}; use Dexterity for monk weapons; bonus action unarmed strike after the Attack action.

description.p: You have a number of ki points equal to your monk level, regained after a short or long rest. Your ki save DC is 8 + proficiency bonus + Wisdom modifier. Flurry of Blows: after the Attack action, spend 1 ki to make two unarmed strikes as a bonus action. Patient Defense: spend 1 ki to Dodge as a bonus action. Step of the Wind: spend 1 ki to Disengage or Dash as a bonus action, and your jump distance is doubled for the turn.

sheet.description: {{level:monk}} ki points; ki save DC {{ki:dc}}. Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, Step of the Wind.

description.p: Your speed increases while you are not wearing armor or wielding a shield: +10 feet at 2nd level, rising to +30 feet at 18th level. At 9th level you can move along vertical surfaces and across liquids on your turn without falling.

You can use your reaction to deflect or catch a missile when hit by a ranged weapon attack, reducing the damage by 1d10 + Dexterity modifier + monk level. If reduced to 0 and you have a free hand, you can catch it and spend 1 ki to throw it back.
You can use your reaction when you fall to reduce any falling damage you take by an amount equal to five times your monk level.
Increase one ability score by 2 or two ability scores by 1 (maximum 20), or take a feat if your game uses feats.
You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

When you hit another creature with a melee weapon attack, you can spend 1 ki point to attempt a stunning strike. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of your next turn.
Your unarmed strikes count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.
When you are subjected to an effect that allows a Dexterity saving throw for half damage, you take no damage on a success and only half damage on a failure.
You can use your action to end one effect on yourself that is causing you to be charmed or frightened.
Increase one ability score by 2 or two ability scores by 1 (maximum 20), or take a feat if your game uses feats.
Your mastery of ki makes you immune to disease and poison.
Increase one ability score by 2 or two ability scores by 1 (maximum 20), or take a feat if your game uses feats.

element.name: Tongue of the Sun and Moon

description.p: You understand all spoken languages, and any creature that can understand a language can understand what you say.
You gain proficiency in all saving throws. Additionally, whenever you make a saving throw and fail, you can spend 1 ki point to reroll it and take the second result.
Your ki sustains you so that you suffer none of the frailty of old age, and you can’t be aged magically. You no longer need food or water.
Increase one ability score by 2 or two ability scores by 1 (maximum 20), or take a feat if your game uses feats.
You can spend 4 ki points to become invisible for 1 minute, with resistance to all damage but force damage. You can also spend 8 ki points to cast astral projection without material components.
Increase one ability score by 2 or two ability scores by 1 (maximum 20), or take a feat if your game uses feats.
When you roll for initiative and have no ki points remaining, you regain 4 ki points.
At 3rd level you commit yourself to a monastic tradition.

Whenever you hit with a Flurry of Blows attack, you can impose one effect: the target must succeed on a Dexterity save or be knocked prone; make a Strength save or be pushed 15 feet; or it can’t take reactions until the end of your next turn.
As an action, you can regain hit points equal to three times your monk level. You must finish a long rest before you can use this feature again.

sheet.description: Regain hit points equal to three times your monk level.

description.p: At the end of a long rest, you gain the effect of a sanctuary spell that lasts until the start of your next long rest (DC 8 + Wisdom modifier + proficiency bonus).

When you hit a creature with an unarmed strike, you can spend 3 ki points to start lethal vibrations. Later, you can use an action to end them: the target must make a Constitution saving throw, dropping to 0 hit points on a failure or taking 10d10 necrotic damage on a success.
Monks of the Way of the Open Hand are the ultimate masters of martial arts combat, whether armed or unarmed.
